parameterGroups.note: 50 retained original stations; 48-point arc-length samples reproduce prior rendered loft, including interpolation between offset anchors. Original CSV and unsampled baseline remain retained. Contract mold lines are not a 1942 survey.

Substantive bridge, funnel and gallery faces shared by CPU/rendering. Small ladders, doors, optics, boat fittings and open lattice remain visual detail, not separate damage modules. Dated fit and source limitations retained.
Physical faceted protection replaces blanket boxes; nominal hull/structure steel is a gameplay estimate. Neither successful export nor plate labels certify a historical armor schedule.

Original machinery/magazine IDs retained. Steering room placed above the rudder stock within the rising counter; bow/after voids added for local flooding. All capacities and room boundaries remain coarse gameplay estimates.

review.title: USS Enterprise (CV-6) · fidelity 01
review.intro: Matched pre-pass and current exported geometry, documented dimensions, structural probes and historical evidence. Both authored stages use the same twelve fixed cameras.
review.limits: No historical accuracy percentage. Exact offsets, many fitting locations, nominal plating and internal room boundaries remain approximations. See discrepancies.md and the source register. The contract scans are split sheets with configuration differences and host redistribution restrictions; they remain local, with no invented whole-ship overlay.
